meta: Make a handbook for new employees with AI: new hires often quit early because no one showed them anything on day one; a 2-page handbook reassures them.

muc.title: Lost on day one
muc.text: New hires often quit early because nobody showed them anything on day one. A two-page handbook helps them feel settled.

muc.title: What goes in the handbook
muc.text: The handbook covers hours, how to request leave, how pay works, the main rules, and who to ask for help.

muc.title: A first-week plan
muc.text: Add a first-week plan: day one, watch and help; day three, work with someone alongside; end of the week, sit down and check in.

muc.title: From notes to handbook
muc.text: Dictate messy notes into your phone and ask a chatbot to arrange them into a handbook with clear sections. Don't paste passwords or the shop's account numbers.

muc.title: Ten questions new hires ask
muc.text: List ten things new hires often ask and ask a chatbot to arrange them into a one-page handbook.
